learning_approach_assessment.assessment_purpose: Assess the learner's preferred learning approach before instruction begins.

questions.question: When you begin studying a new concept related to your goal, what are you most likely to do first?

options.label: A
options.text: I try to understand the idea, connect it to what I already know, and ask myself why it works.

options.label: B
options.text: I focus on remembering the definition and the example exactly as presented.

options.label: C
options.text: I look for the fastest way to cover what will most likely be tested or required.

questions.question: If an exercise is difficult, which response is most like you?

options.label: A
options.text: I compare different ways to think about it and try to understand the reasoning behind the solution.

options.label: B
options.text: I try to memorize the worked example so I can repeat it later.

options.label: C
options.text: I focus on the method most likely to help me complete similar tasks efficiently.
